themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across South America and Europe are aggressively sharpening their electoral strategies and capitalizing on public dissatisfaction ahead of upcoming elections. Leaders are projecting confident victory predictions, challenging mainstream ruling coalitions, and pushing electoral rule changes to solidify political gains.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei publicly claims guaranteed first-round re-election in 2027 while LLA moves to suspend PASO primary elections and consolidate legislative backing.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal campaigns vigorously ahead of regional votes, capitalizing on local insecurity concerns to challenge both the ruling PSOE and main-opposition PP.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP achieves historical high poll numbers, outscoring traditional conservative coalition partners and threatening existing party balances.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella roll out major pension and fiscal platform proposals to position RN as the premier presidential alternative for 2027.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD closes polling gaps with the CDU/CSU nationally while contesting governance roles and coalition boundaries in Saxony-Anhalt.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing formations are increasingly adopting shared rhetorical frames around native priority for state resources and externalized asylum processing. Parties across multiple nations are explicitly invoking the Rwanda offshore model and branding migrant flows as systemic threats to local public services.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Rejects regional budgets lacking explicit 'prioridad nacional' provisions, cuts international aid, and backs Rwanda-style offshore deportation centers.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Formally demands that Norway establish asylum return centers in Rwanda, explicitly imitating UK and European right-wing proposals.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and party leadership attack government migration policy, warning of mass arrivals and demanding aggressive border enforcement.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leadership doubles down on hardline 'remigration' frameworks and border closure rhetoric despite public pushback.

themes.title: Foreign Aid Rollbacks and Skepticism Toward Ukraine Support
themes.blurb: A synchronized push is emerging across European right-wing parties to curtail foreign financial aid and express skepticism toward continued military support for Ukraine. Parties frame external funding as a drain on national budgets and a driver of broader regional instability.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen explicitly pledges that France will halt all new financial aid to Ukraine if she assumes the presidency in 2027.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Polls reveal that over half of FrP voters believe Norway provides too much financial and material aid to Ukraine.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz figures attack opposition pro-Ukraine stances following border strikes, framing Ukraine assistance as escalating security risks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Executes multi-million euro cuts to international development cooperation budgets to redirect state funds domestically.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing movement figures and parties in several countries are facing heightened scrutiny, criminal charges, and legal restrictions from judicial and state security apparatuses, which conservative commentators depict as political lawfare.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes restricts visitation for Jair Bolsonaro as federal prosecutors extend criminal investigations into allies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Domestic intelligence agencies maintain active surveillance on AfD operations while state prosecutors pursue incitement investigations against party members.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish prosecutors press criminal charges against far-right MP Grzegorz Braun, reflecting ongoing legal actions against radical faction leaders.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are escalating campaigns against established media networks and digital regulation frameworks. Across borders, politicians are attempting to block public broadcast funding, preempt European digital mandates, and stall tech regulation bills.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD lawmakers attempt to block state broadcasting treaties (Medienstaatsvertrag) in Saxony-Anhalt to starve public media of funding.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni moves to unilaterally impose youth social media restrictions ahead of pending European Union directives.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Key conservative lawmakers celebrate stalling the 'Big Tech' regulation bill in the Chamber of Deputies, denouncing government censorship.
